claims: BravesVision is a team-owned television network.
BravesVision replaces the Atlanta Braves' previous regional sports network model.
BravesVision provides in-market streaming via Braves.TV.
BravesVision provides cable/satellite access for over 140 games.
In-market fans can subscribe to Braves.TV for $99.99/season.
In-market fans can subscribe to Braves.TV for $19.99/month.
Braves.TV allows watching games without blackouts.
BravesVision includes 25 games simulcast on free, local over-the-air stations through Gray Media.
BravesVision pays homage to the Atlanta Braves' TBS heritage, according to a social media post.
BravesVision includes elements of the late 90s/early 2000s theme in its broadcast open, according to a social media post.
